patch.objective: Weighing cost optimization against other requirements

sources.cite: Google Cloud, Professional Cloud Architect exam guide v6.1 (English exams on or after October 30): Section 1 Designing and planning a cloud solution architecture (~25%), Section 2 (~18%), Section 3 Designing for security and compliance (~19%), Section 4 (~15%), Section 5 (~11%), Section 6 (~12%)
sources.note: Read through a summarizing fetch of the PDF on 2026-11-17. Quoted: 'Cost optimization / resource optimization (CapEx / OpEx)' (4.2), 'Designing for security' (3.1). The v6.1 weights differ slightly from the course seed's (17.5/17.5/15/12.5/12.5); the objective wording is the course seed's. Finding for the verification pass.

sources.cite: Google Cloud, BigQuery pricing: on-demand compute (analysis) pricing
sources.note: Read through a summarizing fetch on 2026-11-14 (no last-updated date on the page). Relevant text: '1 tebibyte and above: $6.25 / 1 tebibyte, per 1 month / account'; 'The first 1 TiB per month is free.' Re-check every six months (12.1).

sources.cite: Google Cloud documentation, Cloud Billing: Create, edit, or delete budgets and budget alerts (last updated 2026-11-10)
sources.note: Read through summarizing fetches on 2026-11-14. Relevant text: 'Setting an alerts-only budget doesn't automatically cap Google Cloud or Google Maps Platform usage or spending'; 'the default alert thresholds are set at 50%, 90%, and 100% of the budget amount'. The page also describes spend cap budgets 'if supported for your service'; which services support them was not read, so the scenario does not offer one.

sources.cite: Google Cloud documentation, BigQuery: Create custom query quotas (last updated 2026-11-10)
sources.note: Read through summarizing fetches on 2026-11-14. Relevant text: 'Project-level custom quotas limit the aggregate usage of all users in that project'; over the quota BigQuery returns 'Custom quota exceeded: Your usage exceeded the custom quota for QueryUsagePerDay'; 'Daily quotas are reset at midnight Pacific Time'; a lower quota 'takes effect within a few minutes'.

sources.cite: Google Cloud documentation, BigQuery: Introduction to partitioned tables (last updated 2026-11-10)
sources.note: Read through a summarizing fetch on 2026-11-14. Relevant text: partitioning can 'improve query performance and control costs by reducing the number of bytes that a query reads'; with a filter on the partitioning column 'BigQuery can scan the partitions that match the filter and skip the rest'.

sources.cite: Google Cloud documentation, Cloud Billing: Enable, disable, or change billing for a project (last updated 2026-11-10)
sources.note: Read through a summarizing fetch on 2026-11-14. Relevant text: when billing is disabled 'all of your Google Cloud and Google Maps Platform services are stopped' and 'some of your Google Cloud resources might be removed and become non-recoverable'; 'We recommend backing up any data that you have in the project.'
